what: A gear-like outline on XY, extruded 10: 24 teeth, each tip an arc on r 50 over half a pitch (π/24), each root an arc on r 44 over the other half, joined by radial lines, every arc round the origin (96 curves: drawn with Design's document functions, as no one would click them).

volume.why: each arc with the origin makes a sector and each radial line points at the origin, adding nothing: 24 tip sectors of ½·50²·π/24 and 24 root sectors of ½·44²·π/24, so π(50² + 44²)/2 = 2218π mm², swept 10

area.why: two caps of 2218π, and sides 10 tall round the outline: the tips 24 · 50 · π/24 = 50π, the roots 44π, and 48 radial lines of 6

topology.why: 2 caps and 96 sides; 96 edges round each cap and 96 along; 96 corners on each cap (192 − 288 + 98 = 2)

box.why: tips start at k · 2π/24, so tips start at 0, π/2, π and 3π/2 (k = 0, 6, 12, 18): the outline reaches ±50 on x and y; z from the sketch at 0 up 10

tolerance.why: LINEAR (10 nm): a model we make ourselves has no entity looser than the kernel's own tolerance
